title: Trade Finance, Letters of Credit and Bank Guarantees
overview: Protecting company assets during transactions with both local and international customers is crucial for business success and sustainability. This course teaches how to effectively engage with foreign companies to boost your revenue while safeguarding assets and maintaining financial stability. Participants will also learn strategies for negotiating favorable commercial terms with trade counterparts.
audience: This course is aimed at financial controllers, procurement professionals, financial analysts, business development managers, financial managers, management accountants, business analysts, and treasury professionals.
methodology: The course combines interactive elements, such as short presentations by the instructor, case studies, and group exercises, allowing participants to apply the knowledge gained throughout the program.
competencies: Using trade finance tools to drive revenue
Managing and mitigating trade finance risks
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the fundamentals and best practices of trade finance
Explore banking facilities related to trade finance
Improve skills in negotiating commercial terms
Understand and utilize various types of letters of credit
Understand and apply different types of bank guarantees
